description:
The process starts when a company schedules a compliance audit for regulations such as ISO standards, safety protocols, or environmental guidelines.
Internal teams prepare documentation, gather evidence, and conduct a self-assessment before the external audit.
Auditors review the company's processes and identify any gaps or issues.
After making the necessary corrections or improvements, the company undergoes a final audit.
If all criteria are met, the company is awarded certification, and the process concludes with the issuance of official documents.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ComplianceAudit" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/compliance-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ComplianceAudit" name="Compliance Audit Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AuditScheduled" name="Compliance audit scheduled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProcesses" name="Review processes and identify gaps or issues"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeCorrections" name="Make necessary corrections or improvements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalAudit" name="Undergo final audit"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CriteriaMet_Split" name="All criteria met?" default="Flow_CriteriaNotMet"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" name="Issue official documents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Certified" name="Certification issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotCertified" name="Certification not awarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Prepare" sourceRef="Start_AuditScheduled" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Gather" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_SelfAssess" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Task_SelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfAssess_Review" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssessment" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Corrections" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProcesses" targetRef="Task_MakeCorrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Corrections_FinalAudit" sourceRef="Task_MakeCorrections" targetRef="Task_FinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalAudit_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_FinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaMet" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet_Split" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${allCriteriaMet}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaNotMet" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet_Split" targetRef="End_NotCertified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Award_Issue" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issue_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" targetRef="End_Certified"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
